disclaimer: This directory was compiled with AI (Claude) assistance from publicly available sources. Every listed row has been through a deep re-verification pass or was researched fresh, and carries the sources used to check it. As of October 2, 2026 every school on the ABA's approved list is listed (198 J.D. schools plus the Army JAG School), checked name-by-name against that list; the coverage line at the top of the site, generated from TODO-missing-schools.csv, will show any school added to the backlog later. Two things to read carefully before drawing conclusions from a tier chip. First, a 'none' or 'standalone' tier means the parent university runs no research-computing resource; it does not mean no compute, because NSF ACCESS allocates national supercomputing time to any researcher at a US academic institution in any field at no cost. Second, a high tier does not guarantee law-school access: some centers list the schools they serve, and Law is not always among them. Run audit.py before submitting a correction.
